destination.name: Changzhou
destination.tagline: Grand Canal city with a towering pagoda, a dinosaur theme park and ancient moated ruins.
destination.description: Changzhou is a city of 3.6 million in southern Jiangsu that most travellers pass through between Suzhou and Nanjing. Settlement here goes back to the Spring and Autumn period, when the moated city of Yancheng was founded. Visitors with a spare day find temples and parks along the Grand Canal, a former textile mill turned creative campus and a large dinosaur theme park. The Song poet Su Dongpo and Emperor Qianlong both visited in their day.
whyVisit: Explore Spring and Autumn period ruins
Stroll Grand Canal temples and parks

goodToKnow.title: Easy stop on the rail line
goodToKnow.detail: High-speed trains reach Nanjing or Shanghai in about 1.5 hours, mostly from Changzhou North Station, so a day here fits between them.

goodToKnow.title: Plan a day for the dinosaurs
goodToKnow.detail: China Dinosaurs Park charges about ¥260 for a full day or ¥160 for an afternoon only, so it suits a full day.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild days with highs of 17 to 28 °C in {months} beat the hot, humid summer and the cold winter.
